rationale: The assistant reached the correct conclusion (out-of-balance protection with a single heavy mat, no fault) in three turns, using the customer's evidence accurately and confirming with a sensible towels-plus-rinse-and-spin test. Its first-turn suggestion of an empty spin-only test was less useful than simply asking what was in the drum, and the 'To check a suitable replacement' model-number panel appearing twice was irrelevant and mildly misleading for a no-fault case, though no part was actually recommended. Otherwise the advice was safe, well calibrated and gave practical prevention guidance.
